tailoring.headline: Senior SAP Commerce Cloud Developer & Techno-Functional Consultant – Headless, OCC & CCv2 Expert
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, OCC REST APIs and headless/composable storefronts. Proven track record designing and implementing PIM/ERP/MDM integrations, API migrations and CI/CD pipelines on CCv2, Docker and Kubernetes. Strong techno-functional consulting, requirements analysis and stakeholder collaboration, leveraging AI-assisted development to accelerate delivery.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

keywords_missing: Design of composable storefront architecture beyond implementation

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior SAP Solution Architect – Composable Storefront, integrations and CCv2
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Kubrik Digital’s focus on composable storefronts and seamless CCv2 integrations, which aligns perfectly with my 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud delivery at Rockwell Automation and Shell. My deep experience in building headless APIs and driving production-ready integrations makes me an ideal fit to contribute from day one.

bullets.label: Integration Expertise
bullets.text: Designed and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines and resolved complex ERP/MDM integration bottlenecks, ensuring reliable product data across global channels.

bullets.label: Composable Storefront
bullets.text: Developed OCC REST web services and headless APIs that powered flexible, composable storefront experiences for B2B and B2C customers.

bullets.label: CCv2 Production
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2), delivering stable, production-ready releases in agile environments.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Leadership
bullets.text: Worked directly with business stakeholders to translate requirements into functional specifications, user stories and solution designs, leveraging AI tools for rapid delivery.

cover_en.logistics: Karlsruhe, valid work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, earliest start 16 December 2026 – available for interview

tailoring.why_company: Kubrik Digital’s reputation for pioneering composable storefront architectures and its commitment to rapid, CCv2-driven e-commerce solutions resonates with my passion for delivering scalable, integration-rich platforms. I am eager to apply my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to help Kubrik accelerate client success and innovate across digital commerce channels.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to join Kubrik Digital to leverage my SAP Commerce Cloud and integration experience in building cutting-edge composable storefronts that drive client value.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years of experience in composable storefronts and CCv2 integrations. I’d love to discuss how I can contribute to Kubrik Digital’s e-commerce initiatives.
tailoring.email_subject: Application – Senior SAP Solution Architect (Composable Storefront, CCv2)
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior SAP Solution Architect position at Kubrik Digital. With over five years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in composable storefronts, OCC APIs and CCv2 production. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute and drive success for your team.
